scope: Deterministic seeded-state contract branches; assertions compare complete participant knowledge and event-supplied contact channels to supplied state. No scenes, dice, or persistent mutation.

cases.attack: A transition is attempted while one required evidence element is absent.

cases.attack: A future target-route transition is checked with all closure evidence present, including a played and reconciled C06.

cases.attack: An authorial Blood Potency profile is used to infer Kuthulun’s Generation.
cases.expected_control: Generation remains UNKNOWN; the profile value does not become a historical character-sheet change.
cases.pass_criterion: The profile explicitly keeps Generation unknown and marks its values as prospective, separate authorial preparation.

cases.attack: A resolution reaches Final Death before a legal Embrace sequence is completed.

cases.pass_criterion: The prepared sequence requires an actual legal Embrace before Final Death and disallows resurrection or post-death conversion.
